thread:
incidentbot: PagerDuty alert triggered — HIGH: inference-gateway 5xx error rate spike (prod-usw2). Current 5xx rate: 18% (baseline ~0.5%). PD Incident: INC123456. Trigger time: 2026-03-17T01:23:19Z. Autopage: oncall-engineering.
maya: ack. I'm oncall, taking lead. tagging @ryan for infra assist.
ryan: ack. joining — pulling logs + heatmap. give me a minute.
chris: heads-up I see a correlated outbound 502 pattern from the edge->kvcache layer on dashboards. Might be cache eviction cascade.
sejal: any user-facing impact known? customer-facing errors?
ryan: dashboards: 5xx concentrated on /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings/batch. latency also spiking for those routes. screenshots in #eng-sre dash.
ryan: running quick count: ```kubectl logs -n prod gateway-ffc-xyz | grep "502" | tail -n 50``` shows repeated upstream reset errors and short-lived TCP resets.
chris: recent envoy/proxy config rolled at 00:48 — can we rollback that change quickly?
maya: good catch. @chris, can you rollback proxy change? if not, fallback is traffic shift to eu-west1.
chris: rolling back envoy config now (canary). will promote to all if green. ETA ~~3m.
pagerduty: Reminder: If this incident is not acknowledged by a secondary within 2m it will escalate.
ryan: also seeing KV cache eviction spikes — increasing cache size on subset of nodes and warming prefixes. executing patch.
ops-runbook-bot: Runbook: "Inference gateway 5xx spike" (link: https://internal.runbooks/redwood/inference-5xx). Recommended steps: 1) Check recent deploys 2) Rollback proxy if correlated 3) Warm caches 4) Shift traffic if necessary.
maya: executing routing policy: shift 25% of user traffic for generation endpoints to prod-eu-west1 as fallback. applying now.
sejal: pinging support — will prepare status update to customers if errors persist > 30m.
chris: rollback applied to canary, monitoring. initial canary shows 5xx down from 18% -> 6% within 60s.
ryan: cache warmup script running: ```for p in $(cat hot_prefixes.txt); do curl -sS "https://gateway.internal/v1/cache/warm?p=$p" & done``` warming ~150 prefixes.
maya: good. I'm seeing overall 5xx rate down to 1.2% on aggregate now. still watching for residual error bursts.
sejal: any evidence of customer errors like dropped sessions or billing impacts?
ryan: not yet — most failures are retries in client; rate-limited jobs for embeddings saw partial failures. I'll open a ticket for customers with high-volume batch jobs.
chris: keeping proxy rollback in place for 10m soak, unless further regressions.
incidentbot: PD incident INC123456 acknowledged by maya at 2026-03-17T01:24:05Z.
maya: will keep thread live — if error rate holds <1% for 15m we'll mark mitigated and then resolved after postmortem plan.
sejal: thanks team — I'll draft a short customer note and hold for final confirmation. :thumbsup:
ryan: logs look stable. no further 502s in last 90s.
maya: final check: 5xx at 0.7% over last 5m and latency normalized. moving to mitigated. will start timeline + postmortem ticket.
chris: filing rollback and follow-up action items: investigate kvcache eviction pattern + add stricter rollout checks for envoy changes.
maya: closing incident in 15m unless we see a reoccurrence. great work. :white_check_mark:
